description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kohuwala, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520801
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically modifying rights of way, parcel numbers, extents, and access rights for multiple land parcels. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, cadastral maps, and property rights adjustments, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
